# Search and answer-engine crawlers share one rule set. The AI crawlers are
# named here rather than left to `*` alone so that their parsers and policy
# scanners see an affirmative Allow (RFC 9309: a crawler obeys only its most
# specific group, so naming them anywhere else would detach them from the
# hygiene rules below). The affirmative `Allow: /` closes the group: RFC 9309
# longest-match parsers rank it below every Disallow wherever it sits, and
# first-match parsers (Python's robotparser) read the Disallows before it.
User-agent: *
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: PerplexityBot
# Each `/*/…` rule covers the locale-prefixed path; its twin below it, the
# unprefixed default-locale one.
Disallow: /*/generator/image?task=*
Disallow: /generator/image?task=*
Disallow: /*/generator/image?initialValues=*
Disallow: /generator/image?initialValues=*
Disallow: /*/profile/*
Disallow: /profile/
Disallow: /*/submit/upload
Disallow: /submit/upload
Disallow: /*/market/submit
Disallow: /market/submit
Disallow: /*/decorations
Disallow: /decorations
Disallow: /*/search
Disallow: /search
# Auth-gated, non-indexed, not in sitemap — crawl-only waste. Retired tabs are
# absent on purpose: they 301 or 404 now, and a blocked URL hides its own answer.
Disallow: /*/collections
Disallow: /collections
Disallow: /*/collection/
Disallow: /collection/
Disallow: /*/@*/tasks
Disallow: /@*/tasks
Disallow: /*/@*/likes
Disallow: /@*/likes
Disallow: /*/@*/credits
Disallow: /@*/credits
Disallow: /*/@*/assets
Disallow: /@*/assets
Disallow: /*/@*/files
Disallow: /@*/files
# Route-manifest prefetch endpoint; no content (each page inlines its own).
Disallow: /__manifest
# React Router loader-data payloads (JSON, no page content); real users still fetch them, only crawlers are blocked.
Disallow: /*.data$
Disallow: /*.data?
# Feed sort/filter variants fold into the plain URL via canonical anyway;
# blocking them saves the crawl needed to discover that (#13365)
Disallow: /*?sort=
Disallow: /*&sort=
Disallow: /*?hidePrompts=
Disallow: /*&hidePrompts=
Disallow: /*?promptVisibility=
Disallow: /*&promptVisibility=
# Legacy path, now the client-only #relevant view; only 301s. `$` spares the fragment.
Disallow: /*/artwork/*/relevant$
Disallow: /artwork/*/relevant$
# Feed cursors duplicate content already reachable via ?page=N.
Disallow: /*_cursor=
Allow: /
# Content Signals (https://contentsignals.org/): allow search indexing and
# answer-time AI reads (consistent with the on-demand fetchers allowed below);
# opt out of third-party AI training. A preference declaration, not enforcement.
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

# On-demand fetchers only (previews, ads checks, user-triggered AI reads).
# Crawlers (Googlebot's tools and the AI crawlers named in the * group above)
# stay under that group so its hygiene rules keep applying to them.
User-agent: AdsBot-Google
User-agent: AdsIdxBot
User-agent: facebookexternalhit
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: Canva-Slackapp-LinkExpanding
User-agent: Twitterbot
User-agent: Pinterestbot
Allow: /

# Training-corpus crawlers with no search or referral surface (Common Crawl,
# ByteDance). This is the enforcement half of the ai-train=no signal above.
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

# PixAI

> PixAI (https://pixai.art) is an AI anime art generation platform. Users generate anime-style images and videos from text prompts, choose from thousands of community-published models and LoRAs (characters, art styles, concepts), train their own LoRAs, and share their work in a creator community. PixAI is operated by Mewtant Inc.

## When to use PixAI

Reach for PixAI when the job is anime, manga, or illustration-style image generation — it is not a general photoreal image model or a chat assistant.

- **Generate an anime-style image from a text prompt**: use the [image generator](https://pixai.art/generator/image) in a browser, or the [REST API](https://platform.pixai.art/en/docs) (see Developer API below). On the web the newest model is [Tsubaki.3](https://pixai.art/tsubaki-3) (native 2K, chat-based editing, reference images, manga pages); Haruka v2 stays a clean SDXL anime option. The API accepts the models listed in the [API docs](https://platform.pixai.art/en/docs/references/models).
- **Reproduce a specific character or art style**: pick a LoRA or model from the [model market](https://pixai.art/market) and use its version id (the API docs show where it goes), or [train a LoRA](https://pixai.art/train-lora) from 10–30 reference images.
- **Edit or restyle an existing image**: image-to-image, inpainting and reference-image generation in the generator (inpainting, outpainting and reference images are also in the API).
- **Find prompts and settings that work**: artworks on the [community feed](https://pixai.art/) whose creators keep prompts visible expose their prompt, model and parameters for remixing (creators can hide them, so not every artwork does).
- **Animate a still image**: [video generation](https://docs.pixai.art/docs/tools/video) in the web app or the API (image-to-video needs a membership).
- **Not a fit**: photorealistic product/people photos, text-heavy graphics, or anything that must run offline — use another tool.

How an agent should call PixAI: read [/index.md](https://pixai.art/index.md) for the site in markdown. For the API, the [developer documentation](https://platform.pixai.art/en/docs) is canonical. API access is granted per account by application; there is no anonymous or sandbox tier.

## What you can do on PixAI

- [AI image generator](https://pixai.art/generator/image): text-to-image and image-to-image anime art generation with adjustable models, LoRAs, sizes and sampling settings
- [Model market](https://pixai.art/market): community-published generation models and LoRAs for specific characters, art styles and concepts
- [Creative tools](https://pixai.art/ai-tools): one-click themed generators (AI anime generator, anime figures, character cards, plushies, trading cards and more)
- [LoRA training](https://pixai.art/train-lora): train a custom character or style LoRA from your own images
- [Community feed](https://pixai.art/): browse, search and remix published artworks with visible prompts and generation parameters
- [Contests](https://pixai.art/contest): official and community art contests
- [PixAI Agent (Mio)](https://agent.pixai.art): conversational agent for generating and iterating on anime art

## Pricing and credits

- [Membership plans](https://pixai.art/membership/plans): free accounts receive daily credits that can be claimed and spent on generation; paid memberships add monthly credits, faster queues and feature unlocks. Credit amounts and perks are listed on this page — treat it as the source of truth, since values change over time.
- [Credit costs](https://docs.pixai.art/docs/pricing/credits-cost) and [earning credits](https://docs.pixai.art/docs/pricing/credits-earn): what a generation costs and how free credits accrue

## Usage terms and commercial use

- [Terms of Service](https://pixai.art/terms): governing terms, including content and usage rights. Rights to generated images can also depend on the license of the specific model or LoRA used — check the model's page in the market.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pixai.art/privacy), [Copyright Policy](https://pixai.art/copyright), [operator disclosure](https://pixai.art/legal)

## Developer API

Use the PixAI API to integrate image and video generation into applications. The official documentation is the source of truth for parameters, limits and how-to guides.

- [API documentation](https://platform.pixai.art/en)
- [First API call](https://platform.pixai.art/en/docs/quick-start/first-api-call)
- [Getting API access](https://platform.pixai.art/en/docs/quick-start/enroll-in-api) (beta; granted per account by application)
- [Limits](https://platform.pixai.art/en/docs/quick-start/limits)
- Official SDKs: [@pixai-art/client (JavaScript)](https://github.com/pixai-art/pixai-client-js) and [pixai-client-go](https://github.com/pixai-art/pixai-client-go) on the [pixai-art GitHub organization](https://github.com/pixai-art)

## Machine-readable resources

- [/index.md](https://pixai.art/index.md): this site in markdown
- [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://pixai.art/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 API catalog
- [/.well-known/ard.json](https://pixai.art/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery catalog (API, docs)
- [/sitemap.xml](https://pixai.art/sitemap.xml) and [/robots.txt](https://pixai.art/robots.txt) (carries the Content-Signal policy: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no)
- Documentation sites publish their own: [docs.pixai.art/llms.txt](https://docs.pixai.art/llms.txt) (user guide) and [platform.pixai.art/llms.txt](https://platform.pixai.art/llms.txt) (API)

## Apps

- [iOS app](https://apps.apple.com/app/pixai-ai-anime-art-generator/id6474528911)
- [Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.mewtant.pixaiart)

## News and updates

- [Official news](https://pixai.art/news): product announcements, feature launches and contest results

## Official social accounts

- [X (Twitter)](https://x.com/PixAI_Official)
- [X (Twitter, English)](https://x.com/PixAI_EN)
- [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/pixai)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/pixai_official)
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@pixai.art.official)
- [YouTube (global)](https://www.youtube.com/@PixaiART)
- [YouTube (Japan)](https://www.youtube.com/@PixAIJP)
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100081244069311)

## Company and press

- [Metanomaly Inc.](https://metanomaly.co.jp/): the Mewtant group's Japan entity
- [Wikidata: PixAI](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q136795461), [Wikidata: Mewtant Inc.](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141366560), [Wikidata: Metanomaly株式会社](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141366590): knowledge-graph records
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/pixai-art): official SDKs and open-source projects
- [Press releases (PR TIMES)](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/searchrlp/company_id/173726)
- Business and media inquiries: inquiries@pixai.art (not monitored for user support — use the [contact page](https://pixai.art/feedback))
